load_yaml_with_includes: load a YAML config file that supports recursive includes via an includes list key
create_Configuration_from_args: create a Configuration object by merging default YAML, user YAML, and CLI dotlist overrides
get_config_from_Configuration: get the merged OmegaConf config dictionary from an existing Configuration instance
freeze_Configuration: freeze a Configuration object so its config becomes immutable via OmegaConf struct mode
pretty_print_Configuration: pretty print the training, dataset, optimizer, scheduler, and model config sections to a writer
